dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Jagged, high-contrast white perimeters forming irregular closed and semi-closed loops; sharp transition from bright white edges to dark grey and black interiors with visible internal speckling.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, irregular white pixel clusters located primarily in the mid-to-lower lateral regions, characterized by solid intensity and a lack of internal gradients or central voids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangular arrangement; a sequence of four smaller annuli near the neck region form a localized linear-curved spatial relationship.
